title: poco a poco : Harmonize our voices?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, coming iiiiin… 
Whew～.
Feels kinda weird coming into another class's
room.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there she is! 
Kei-cha— Oops.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Haha…! Light O rubbing off on you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ngh… She called you that so confidently,
it just kind of stuck…! Sorry～

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's okay.
You can call me "Kei-chan" if you want
to. 
…Maybe I'll call you "Kuu-chan" while we're
in the group.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A-are you sure? It's kind of embarrassing,
but… Eh, whatever. 
Ahem. So,
Kei-chan. Are we good to go for practice?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
We sure are,
Kuu-chan!
It's a good thing they're letting us borrow
an empty classroom.
Should we hurry over there?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
——Hmm! Such a lovely tune,
no matter how many times I hear it.
I can hardly wait to sing it.
Your choice of song is much appreciated,
Miracle-san.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you like it.
As for splitting up the parts… 
Is everyone okay with the groups we played
rock-paper-scissors for?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
So that's me and Mirako-senpai as the main
duo… Right? 
Agh～ I- I'll try not to drag you guys
down…!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I might drag you guys down too! …Actually,
Kei-chan,
are you sure you want to be doing the
accompaniment?
I know you're the only one who can play the
piano, but…

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry!
As long we can make the kids happy,
that's all I need.
I'll do everything I can to support your
singing.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Are we done talking now?
Then we should hurry up and sing.
I have listened to the song a lot on x50
speed so I am completely prepared.
Let's start LAAAAAA LAAAAAA!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, I'm glad you're motivated! 
Okay.
Let's give singing it together a shot.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: …It's…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: It's hard!?!?!?!?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
U-utter defeat… To think a song could lead
me so astray…! 
I had completely lost track of my part
halfway through…

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
That was so messy I can't even believe it.
That wasn't a choir at all that was just noise.
Also by the way the tempo was all over the
place too.
Mainly because I was going too fast.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I might've been too slow～ Ngh,
I can handle this stuff at Winning Concerts,
so I thought I'd be better at this～!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Me too… But now that I think about it,
those songs don't usually split parts or
harmonize like that, huh?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
The songs we usually sing have everyone
singing the main melody together… Splitting
it up chorus style is really tough～

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm… 
All right.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
How about we focus on the individual parts
for now? 
Everyone can learn their own part first,
and we can go from there.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I understand.
Individual parts… If I may confirm,
we will be using recordings of the song to
practice alone, yes?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Not alone. 
After all, I need to put in the work too.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Oof…! Sorry for the wait, Dantsu!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't worry…! If anything,
I'm sorry for interrupting your training!
I feel like I'm forcing you to follow my
schedule…

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Not at all.
Thanks for making time for me even though
you're so busy.
We might have a little post-training fatigue,
but do you think we're good to go?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Y-yes! All ready to go…!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
——Yeah, that was really good.
Sounds like you're getting a handle on the
melody!
All we need now is… If you sing with a little
more oomph, you'll get even better.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Oomph… Oh,
so that's it. Since we're in a choir,
I got it in my head that I didn't want to
stick out too much…

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You're being considerate for the harmony,
huh? Haha, you really are a nice girl,
Dantsu. But it's okay! Right now,
it's just you and me. Got it?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I want to hear as much of your kind,
cheerful singing as I can. 
Would you do that for me, Dantsu?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
…! 
O-okay! I'll give it a shot…!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
——Now I get it.
I was wondering why we were going on a walk
when we're supposed to be practicing for a
song and I almost suspected you were just
being lazy to be honest.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
So your plan was to get me to learn to match
your tempo by walking.
Well it worked you got me.
Though actually I did end up going faster
than you a lot anyway.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Hey,
running together for a bit was pretty fun
too. ——Oh,
now I remember.
This park actually lets you borrow boats.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You need a pretty good sense of rhythm to
row a boat. 
I think it'll make for good practice.
Want to try it out?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I accept.
Rowing a boat together on the weekend is an
absolute classic date.
Let's make like a couple of lovebirds and
start rowing all lovey-dovey-like right
now.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? …Pff. Hahaha! 
You say some really funny stuff, huh,
Light O…!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
——Okay. So you worried too much,
and started getting a little anxious, huh?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Indeed… A knight must never show her shameful
side to an audience,
after all… But when I started thinking
that…

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A knight… That's it! 
Durandal, I think we can use that.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Let your imagination take the wheel and
build a world around you… Really immerse
yourself in that world,
until you're not worried about performing
in front of a crowd anymore!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I… I see? Build a world,
imagination… A singing knight… 
No, that's not right.
A knight would hide her identity,
and disguise herself as a songstress…!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good!
And maybe you can imagine you're in an opera
house. And… How about this?
The monarch's sitting in the royal box,
watching you sing.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
They are!? To think,
my liege… is listening to my song——!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(It's working,
it's working! I can see it!
The glistening of the chandelier,
the elegance of the opera house, Miracle-san,
the maestro on the organ! And of course——)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(The songstress for but one night,
with her liege watching over her —— ME! Ahh,
on this evening,
your knight shall sing for you a song of
admiration!)

Laaaa～♪ 
Lalalaaaaa～♪
text_block_list.name: Durandal
K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(She's doing great!
…Reminds me of when the kids at the hospital
would play pretend. Hehe.
I'm glad I could help her.)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
La la!! La! 
Laaaaaaaa～♪♪♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa… Durandal-chan keeps getting better
and better. 
She's singing really well,
like she's really letting loose…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Kei-chan's… she's pretty awesome, huh?
